+import torch
+import triton
+import triton.language as tl

+    weights,
+    expert_ids,
+    width: tl.constexpr,
+    topk: tl.constexpr,
+    weight_stride0,
+    weight_stride1,
+    id_stride0,
+    id_stride1,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
